projects.title: Web-Based Church Management System
projects.context: Archdiocese of Kota Kinabalu · Final Year Project
projects.summary: A web-based system that brings church information, announcements, bulletins, events, sacraments, pastoral care, catechesis and donations for the 23 churches in Kota Kinabalu into one place, with separate access for members, church admins and a super admin.
projects.problem: Church information, bulletins, announcements and services across the 23 churches in Kota Kinabalu needed a single, central web platform.
projects.approach: Following the Waterfall methodology: requirements analysis, database design, implementation and testing. Built in plain PHP with PDO and MySQL, with three roles: member, church admin and super admin.
features: Church directory with priests, mass times and contact details
Announcements and digital bulletins, with email notifications to subscribers
Event registration with capacity limits and email reminders
Sacrament applications, schedules and confession slot booking
Pastoral care requests with admin review
Catechesis enrolment and attendance tracking
Donations with receipt upload, admin review and reports
AI assistant and AI-assisted announcement writing (Gemini API)
projects.outcome: Currently in development as my Final Year Project.

projects.title: SchoolFam
projects.summary: An AI-powered parent–school communication platform that brings classroom updates, attendance, pickup, health, billing and messaging together for parents, teachers and school admins.
projects.problem: Parents and schools communicate through scattered channels, so daily updates, absences, pickups, fees and incidents are easy to miss.
projects.approach: Built as a browser-based React and TypeScript prototype in Google AI Studio, with role-based screens for parents, teachers, admins and a super admin, realistic sample data, and a Gemini-powered daily summary for parents.
features: Daily activity feed and photo moments
AI Smart Daily Summary for parents (Gemini)
Attendance tracking and absence requests
Pickup management with guardian verification and on-screen signature
Health records and incident reports with parent acknowledgement
Chat, announcements and notifications
Calendar with RSVPs
Billing with proof-of-payment verification, and a school shop
Feedback tickets, homework and signed documents
Invite and access codes for teacher and parent sign-up
projects.outcome: Received Overall Best Project recognition and achieved first runner-up in a Technopreneurship Business Idea Pitching competition.
